skill.summary: Fill XFA (Adobe LiveCycle) PDF forms programmatically. Use when working with .pdf files that have Form: XFA (check with pdfinfo). Standard tools like pdftk,...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release — generic XFA (Adobe LiveCycle) form filler. Discovers fields, fills via --set/-d/--stdin, handles duplicates with array values. Hyperion-reviewed code + docs.
